<content>
1: // Canvas Asteroid Dodge game
2: (() => {
3:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
4:   if (!canvas) return;
5:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
6:   const width = canvas.width;
7:   const height = canvas.height;
8: 
9:   // Sound assets (replace data URIs with actual files if desired)
10:   const bgMusic = new Audio('data:audio/ogg;base64,T2dnUwACAAAAAAAAAABVDwAAAAAAAABJRU5ErkJggg=='); // placeholder silent audio
11:   bgMusic.loop = true;
12:   const collideSound = new Audio('data:audio/wav;base64,//uQxAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAASW5mbwAAAA8AAAACAAACABAAZGF0YQAAAAA='); // placeholder beep
13: 
14:   // Ship definition
15:   const ship = { x: width / 2, y: height - 30, w: 20, h: 20, speed: 4 };
16:   const keys = {};
17:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => (keys[e.key] = true));
18:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.key] = false));
19: 
20:   // Asteroid pool
21:   const asteroids = [];
22:   // Starfield
23:   const stars = [];
24:   const starCount = 100;
25:   for (let i = 0; i < starCount; i++) {
26:     stars.push({
27:       x: Math.random() * width,
28:       y: Math.random() * height,
29:       bright: Math.random() < 0.2,
30:     });
31:   }
32:   let lastSpawn = 0;
33:   const spawnInterval = 800; // ms
34: 
35:   let startTime = null;
36:   let gameOver = false;
37: 
38:   function spawnAsteroid() {
39:     const radius = 10 + Math.random() * 15;
40:     const x = Math.random() * (width - radius * 2) + radius;
41:     const speedY = 1 + Math.random() * 2;
42:     const speedX = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.5;
43:     asteroids.push({ x, y: -radius, r: radius, vx: speedX, vy: speedY });
44:   }
45: 
46:   function rectCircleCollide(rect, circle) {
47:     const distX = Math.abs(circle.x - rect.x - rect.w / 2);
48:     const distY = Math.abs(circle.y - rect.y - rect.h / 2);
49:     if (distX > rect.w / 2 + circle.r) return false;
50:     if (distY > rect.h / 2 + circle.r) return false;
51:     if (distX <= rect.w / 2) return true;
52:     if (distY <= rect.h / 2) return true;
53:     const dx = distX - rect.w / 2;
54:     const dy = distY - rect.h / 2;
55:     return dx * dx + dy * dy <= circle.r * circle.r;
56:   }
57: 
58:   function update(dt) {
59:     // ship movement
60:     if (keys.ArrowLeft) ship.x -= ship.speed;
61:     if (keys.ArrowRight) ship.x += ship.speed;
62:     if (keys.ArrowUp) ship.y -= ship.speed;
63:     if (keys.ArrowDown) ship.y += ship.speed;
64:     // keep within bounds
65:     ship.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(width - ship.w, ship.x));
66:     ship.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(height - ship.h, ship.y));
67: 
68:     // spawn asteroids
69:     if (performance.now() - lastSpawn > spawnInterval) {
70:       spawnAsteroid();
71:       lastSpawn = performance.now();
72:     }
73: 
74:     // move asteroids
75:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
76:       const a = asteroids[i];
77:       a.x += a.vx;
78:       a.y += a.vy;
79:       // remove off-screen
80:       if (a.y - a.r > height) asteroids.splice(i, 1);
81:       // collision
82:       if (rectCircleCollide(ship, a)) {
83:         gameOver = true;
84:         collideSound.play();
85:       }
86:     }
87: 
88:     // update stars (scroll down for parallax effect)
89:     for (let i = stars.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
90:       const s = stars[i];
91:       s.y += 0.5; // slow drift
92:       if (s.y > height) {
93:         s.y = 0;
94:         s.x = Math.random() * width;
95:       }
96:       // occasional twinkle
97:       if (Math.random() < 0.01) s.bright = !s.bright;
98:     }
99:   }
100: 
101:   function draw() {
102:     // background – black with starfield
103:     ctx.fillStyle = 'black';
104:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
105:     // draw stars
106:     stars.forEach(s => {
107:       ctx.fillStyle = s.bright ? 'white' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)';
108:       ctx.fillRect(s.x, s.y, 1, 1);
109:     });
110:     // ship – triangular with gradient
111:     ctx.save();
112:     const shipGradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(ship.x, ship.y, ship.x, ship.y + ship.h);
113:     shipGradient.addColorStop(0, '#00ffff');
114:     shipGradient.addColorStop(1, '#0066ff');
115:     ctx.fillStyle = shipGradient;
116:     ctx.translate(ship.x + ship.w / 2, ship.y + ship.h / 2);
117:     ctx.beginPath();
118:     ctx.moveTo(0, -ship.h / 2);
119:     ctx.lineTo(-ship.w / 2, ship.h / 2);
120:     ctx.lineTo(ship.w / 2, ship.h / 2);
121:     ctx.closePath();
122:     ctx.fill();
123:     ctx.restore();
124:     // asteroids – radial gradient
125:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
126:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(a.x, a.y, a.r * 0.2, a.x, a.y, a.r);
127:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#888888');
128:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#222222');
129:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
130:       ctx.beginPath();
131:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
132:       ctx.fill();
133:     });
134:     // score
135:     const elapsed = ((performance.now() - startTime) / 1000).toFixed(1);
136:     ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
137:     ctx.font = '16px monospace';
138:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${elapsed}s`, 10, 20);
139:     if (gameOver) {
140:       ctx.fillStyle = 'red';
141:       ctx.font = '24px monospace';
142:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2 - 60, height / 2);
143:     }
144:   }
145: 
146:   let musicStarted = false;
147:   function loop(timestamp) {
148:     if (!startTime) startTime = timestamp;
149:     // start background music once
150:     if (!musicStarted) {
151:       bgMusic.play().catch(() => {});
152:       musicStarted = true;
153:     }
154:     const dt = timestamp - (lastFrame ?? timestamp);
155:     lastFrame = timestamp;
156:     if (!gameOver) {
157:       update(dt);
158:       draw();
159:       requestAnimationFrame(loop);
160:     } else {
161:       draw(); // final frame with Game Over
162:     }
163:   }
164:   let lastFrame = null;
165:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
166: })();

(End of file - total 166 lines)
</content>
